Coram :

Hon'Ble Mr Justice K.Somashekar
 Oral Order
Learned counsel Sri Gangaraja.C for petitioners is on record.
He has filed a memo dated 07.06.2024 seeking withdrawal of the petition.
Therefore, the memo is taken on record.
In terms of the said memo, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
Learned HCGP is directed to accept the notice in respect of the Respondent/State.
Accordingly, the petition is disposed of.
